$comment: Advisories reviewed and accepted. A key is either a GHSA id (accepts that one advisory) or a package name (accepts every advisory in that package). Each needs a reason saying why it is not reachable here, and the date it was reviewed. An entry is a decision, not a snooze — re-check it when the dependency moves. Everything else fails the build; see .github/scripts/audit-gate.ts.

minimatch.reason: Dev-only: reaches the tree through @typescript-eslint, ESLint, stylelint, Jest and Cypress. Never bundled and never in a request path. Sits at majors 3, 5, 9 and 10 simultaneously, so a single override would force one major onto consumers that cannot take it.

brace-expansion.reason: Dev-only, via the same ESLint/Jest/Cypress chain as minimatch. Present at majors 1, 2 and 5 at once, so it cannot be pinned with a blanket override.

js-yaml.reason: Dev-only: @cypress/code-coverage and @eslint/eslintrc. Parses this repo's own config files, never attacker input. Majors 3 and 4 coexist.

postcss.reason: Build-time only: stylelint and the postcss plugin chain process our own stylesheets during the build, not user input at runtime. Majors 7 and 8 coexist.

ajv.reason: Dev-only: ESLint config validation. Majors 6 and 8 coexist, and forcing 6 onto an 8 consumer breaks its schema API.

serialize-javascript.reason: Build-time only: terser-webpack-plugin and workbox-build under next-pwa, which serialise our own bundle config during the webapp build. Majors 4 and 6 coexist.

GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr.reason: Runtime, not dev-only — the only such entry here, so it is neutralised in our code rather than out of reach. Reaches us solely through @turbodocx/html-to-docx, which inlines image-size into its own bundle, so an override or patch changes nothing it runs; first_patched_version is null and the <= 2.0.2 range covers every published version. DOCX export now sniffs magic bytes and inlines only png or jpeg, so the ICNS parser is never handed input — see apps/hocuspocus.server/CLAUDE.md §HTTP Modules. Held at high so a rescore to critical still fails.

GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq.reason: Same dependency and same mitigation as GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr — the JXL and HEIF parsers rather than ICNS. Sniffing at upload would not have covered this one: image/heic and image/heif are deliberately allowed there, so HEIF has to be dropped at the export boundary rather than declared safe. Drop both entries together.
